A.unit: Eight distinct deterministic process-level adversarial controls: three real matching, forced 2s stall, 1ms budget, corrupt JSON, injected crash, stdout flooding.

C.primary: Eight tests return their predetermined status: PASS x3, RESOURCE_HARD_WALL x2, INVALID_WORKER_JSON x1, WORKER_FAILURE x1, RESOURCE_OUTPUT x1.
C.time_falsifier: A deliberately stalled child must be terminated by parent before 1750ms despite its 2000ms CPU stall, and the same applies to a 1ms budget on real matching.
C.certification_falsifier: Any failure status includes a certified matching or any successful control fails Python exact objective verification.
C.interpretation: Only process-level enforcement on this Windows/Node environment; not universal OS-level guarantee or sociological evidence.
